headline: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Shares Housing Data, Is The Stock Fully Valued?
summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) just released its June 2026 First Look on mortgage delinquency, foreclosure, and prepayment trends, giving investors fresh housing market context ahead of the company’s upcoming earnings report. headline: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Stock Looks Close To Fair Value Today
summary: Intercontinental Exchange stock has delivered a 31.5% gain over the past three years, yet today the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate points to a roughly fair price while earnings multiples lean expensive, leaving investors with a valuation picture that is not one sided. Over the past three years, Intercontinental Exchange has returned 31.5%, which reflects meaningful value creation over a medium term horizon even though more recent returns have been weaker.
